1.title: Event Name Counts / Unique User
1.query:
fetch user.events
| filterOut isNull(name)
| summarize count = countDistinct(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{name}
| sort count desc

3.title: PlayStore Rank by Language
3.query:
timeseries rank=avg(business.store.rank, scalar:true), by:{language}
| fieldsKeep language, rank

4.title: PlayStore Rank, by Search Term
4.query:
timeseries rank=avg(business.store.rank, scalar:true), by:{searchterm}
| fieldsKeep searchterm, rank

6.title: User count
6.query:
fetch user.events
| summarize userCount = countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{}

7.title: User count / OS Versions
7.query:
fetch user.events
| summarize count = countDistinct(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{os.version}

9.title: User count / App Versions last 7days
9.query:
fetch user.events
| makeTimeseries countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{app.version}, interval:1h

10.title: User count / Phone Vendor (Top 10)
10.query:
fetch user.events
| summarize count = countDistinct(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{device.manufacturer}
| sort count desc
| limit 10

12.title: HTTP Request / Domain / Status
12.query:
fetch user.events
| filterOut isNull(url.domain)
| summarize count = count(), by:{url.domain, http.response.status_code}
| sort count desc

13.title: Crashed Users
13.query:
fetch user.events
| filter error.is_fatal == true
| filter dt.rum.application.entity == "MOBILE_APPLICATION-7F12FDD27DFB40A2"
| summarize count=countDistinct(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{}

24.title: User count / View (Top 20)
24.query:
fetch user.events
| filterOut isNull(view.name)
| summarize count = countDistinct(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{view.name}
| sort count desc
| limit 10

25.title: DAU
25.query:
fetch user.events
| makeTimeseries count=countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{}, interval:24h
| fieldsAdd DAU = arrayAvg(count)

26.title: WAU
26.query:
fetch user.events
| makeTimeseries count=countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{}, interval:7d
| fieldsAdd WAU = arrayAvg(count)

28.title: DAU/WAU Ratio
28.query:
fetch user.events
| makeTimeseries DAU_a=countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{}, interval:24h
| fieldsAdd j=1, DAU = arrayAvg(DAU_a)
| join [
  fetch user.events
  | makeTimeseries WAU_a=countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id), by:{}, interval:7d
  | fieldsAdd j=1, WAU = arrayAvg(WAU_a)
], on:{j}, prefix:"w."
| join [
  fetch user.events
  | summarize MAU = countDistinctExact(dt.rum.instance.id)
  | fieldsAdd j=1
], on:{j}, prefix:"m."
| fieldsKeep DAU, w.WAU, m.MAU
| fieldsRename WAU = w.WAU, MAU = m.MAU
| fieldsAdd d_w_ratio=DAU/WAU*100, w_m_ratio=WAU/MAU*100
